topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen recognition and innate immune receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through pattern recognition receptors and their downstream signaling pathways.

topics.label: Cellular inflammatory response, recruitment, and systemic effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the cellular execution of inflammation, covering sentinel cell activation, leukocyte recruitment to tissues, lymphatic transport, and systemic escalation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms that shut down inflammation, repair damaged tissue, and lead to chronic inflammatory adaptations such as granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the complement system.
